classifications.rationale: Executive departments and agencies must condition future federal-assistance approvals on applicants accepting specified construction-contract obligations; the legally consequential conditions arise through later agency approvals and contracts.
classifications.evidence: require as a condition for the approval of any grant, contract, loan, insurance or guarantee

classifications.rationale: Upon the Committee's recommendation, the administering agency must later cancel, suspend, or terminate an agreement, withhold assistance, or refer the case after applicant noncompliance; notice and a hearing precede specified funding or contractual consequences.
classifications.evidence: upon the recommendation of the Committee, shall take any or all of the following actions

classifications.rationale: Government contracting agencies must insert specified nondiscrimination clauses into future contracts, making the prescribed obligations binding through later contracting rather than through the amendment alone.
classifications.evidence: all Government contracting agencies shall include in every Government contract hereafter entered into the following provisions

classifications.rationale: The provision assigns the Committee discretionary exemption authority, changes Committee membership and internal coverage, and sets effective dates; it does not itself grant a particular exemption or dictate a later exemption outcome.
classifications.evidence: The Committee may, when it deems that special circumstances in the national interest so require, exempt a contracting agency
